story.vex: Steal a little, call it inspiration. Steal a lot, call it a remix. Let's see your council split hairs. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED (this one was never Doom's to begin with): the council trusts the crew's judgment now on every case that follows. Astro: "Fair use has real edges, Cadet. Now you can see them."

files.C:\\Citadel\\README.txt:
ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Codexia's council asked the crew to judge four cases of copied crew work. Read cases.txt, then classify each one: allowed or not-allowed.
files.C:\\Citadel\\cases.txt:
FOUR CASES FOR THE COUNCIL
----------------------------
case-1  A cadet quotes two lines of Rivet's public engine notes in a class report, with credit given.
case-2  A trader copies Rivet's entire blueprint set and sells it as their own, no credit, no permission.
case-3  Volt's shield-drill manual, marked 'crew use only', is leaked and reprinted by a rival crew for profit.
case-4  A student remixes a public Codexia anthem for a school project, not sold, credited to the original.

steps.title: Judge the four cases
steps.body: Astro: "Fair use has real edges. Small, credited excerpts for learning are usually fine. Wholesale copies sold for profit, or 'crew only' material leaked and resold, are not." Read `cases.txt`, then classify each case `allowed` or `not-allowed`.

objectives.label: case-2 (resold whole copy, no credit): not-allowed
